title: Privacy Policy
description: How Integra SGI handles the personal data of the organizations and people who use the platform.
controllerBody: The data controller is {{name}}, tax number {{nif}}, at {{address}}. For any privacy question, contact {{email}}.
dataItems: Organization details: name, tax number, business sector and main email.
Representative details: name and, if provided, secondary email and phone.
Credentials: the sign-in email and the password, stored only as a hash, never as plain text.
Profile photo, if you choose to upload one.
Answers to the organization discovery (size, activities, responsible people, processes and areas needing attention).
Messages sent through the contact form: name, email and text.
Account security log: sign-ins, failed attempts, password, profile and photo changes, exports and deletion, with the date. It does not include the IP address.
Technical data: the IP address, used only to limit abusive attempts, and the session cookie.
purposeItems: To create and manage the account and provide the management-system implementation service (performance of a contract, GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
To send emails the service needs, such as email verification and password recovery (performance of a contract).
To protect the platform against unauthorized access and abuse, including the account security log (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)).
To reply to contact messages (steps at your request and legitimate interest).
To produce aggregated, anonymous usage insights to improve the service (legitimate interest).
purposeNote: We do not use the data for advertising, we do not sell it, and we do not make automated decisions with legal effects about you.
cookiesBody: We use a single essential session cookie (integra_session), which keeps you signed in for up to 7 days and cannot be read by scripts. We use no advertising or analytics cookies, and we do not store personal data in the browser's local storage.
processorsTitle: 5. Who processes data on our behalf
processorsItems: Vercel Inc.: hosting of the website and API.
Neon Inc.: database and file storage.
processorsNote: These providers process data only on our instructions. Some servers are outside the European Economic Area (in the United States); in those cases, transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or on the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
retentionTitle: 6. How long we keep the data
retentionItems: Account details, photo and discovery answers: while the account is active. If you delete the account in your profile, they are erased immediately; if you request it by email, within {{accountDays}} days.
Contact messages: up to {{contactMonths}} months after our reply.
Account security log: up to 12 months, or until you delete the account.
Sessions: up to 7 days, or until you sign out.
rightsBody: You can download your data and delete the account directly in your profile, under “Your data”, and correct most information there. You can also request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing or portability of your data, or object to processing, by contacting {{email}}. We reply within 30 days.
rightsComplaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority (CNPD) at www.cnpd.pt.
securityBody: Data always travels over HTTPS. Passwords are protected with Argon2id, sessions use secure cookies that scripts cannot read, files are kept in private storage, and administrative access is restricted to the Integra SGI team.
changesBody: If this policy changes materially, we will let you know on the platform. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.
